name: gizza-ai/nt-hash
summary: Compute the NT (NTLM) hash of a password

tool.description: Compute the NT hash (NTLM hash / NTOWF) of a password: MD4(UTF-16LE(password)), a 128-bit digest returned by default as 32 lowercase hex chars. Set output_format='base64' for base64, or uppercase=true for uppercase hex. NOTE: the NT hash is unsalted and MD4 is broken — use it for password audits, CTFs, and NTLM/pass-the-hash interop, not for storing new passwords (use argon2-hash or bcrypt-hash).

password.description: The password (or any text) to hash.

uppercase.description: Emit uppercase hex (no effect on base64). Default false.
